name: omp-hub-web
description: omp hub web UI: machines, sessions, and the vendored collab guest client

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./index.html --splitting --outdir=dist --minify --public-path=/ --entry-naming=[hash].[ext] --chunk-naming=[hash].[ext] --asset-naming=[hash].[ext] && mv dist/*.html dist/index.html && cp -R public/. dist/ && bun scripts/fix-html-entry.ts
